claim: In 2019, New York recorded 52.6 inches of precipitation, more than Orlando's 47.8 inches and Seattle's 30.7 inches.

Counting days with more than 0.1 mm (0.004 in) of precipitation as wet, the 2019 wet-day counts were: Hilo 218, Grand Rapids 124, Seattle 112, New York 109, Orlando 96, Baton Rouge 96, Atlanta 94, Houston 74, Los Angeles 32 and Phoenix 26.
